# Bundled runtime

Pyodide 0.27.7, including CPython 3.12.7 and its standard library.
The five runtime files were obtained unmodified from the official distribution:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.27.7/full/

Project: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.27.7
Pyodide licensing: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/blob/0.27.7/LICENSE
Python license and third-party acknowledgements: https://docs.python.org/3.12/license.html

These files are redistributed to make this educational application locally
self-contained. They are third-party components and are not original PrintFlow
source. Embedded license notices remain unchanged.
